name: Fee And Tax 2
definition: Amount of money associated with a service.

CommercialAgreementReference.name: Commercial Agreement Reference
CommercialAgreementReference.definition: Reference to the agreement established between the fund and another party. This element, amongst others, defines the conditions of the commissions.

DigitalNetworkFee.name: Digital Network Fee
DigitalNetworkFee.definition: Digital payment settlement information or digital network fee assigned to a transaction.

FeeTaxElementRule.definition: One of the elements (CommercialAgreementReference, IndividualFee, IndividualTax, DigitalNetworkFee) must be present.
